body: DEV-05.2A.3F — USER GOVERNANCE DECISION / LIMITED FEASIBILITY AUTHORIZATION. User explicitly authorizes Parikshit to serve concurrently as Collector/runtime engineering owner and Independent verification owner for this isolated DEV-05.2A.3F native recovery feasibility study. This resolves the dual-role governance question raised in issue comment 6414169224. Prior explicit owner declarations: runtime APPROVED; verification APPROVED; no extra conditions, ADR revision 5fc003b8e026eb4a3479c77084ef8ef894417173. Authorization assessment: ROLE-COVERAGE/DUAL-ROLE GOVERNANCE APPROVED FOR FEASIBILITY ONLY; isolated ADR N1–N4 candidate-evaluation work may proceed within the approved scope, contingent on exact authoritative maintained upstream candidate identity/support/provenance and documented reproducible independent test evidence. The same person may own both roles, but cannot substitute assertion for independently collected source-ID inventory, committed API/PostgreSQL receipts, crash-cut evidence, duplicate/missing-ID reconciliation, hashes and test logs. A custom fork/build, product-code change, production integration, version/guard transition, merge, deploy, publish, release waiver or DEV-05.2B requires separate authorization. If no authoritative supported candidate exists, document BLOCKED and upstream proposal; do not silently broaden scope. Keep 0.123.0 production pin, PR #69 draft, CHK-001 FAIL, CHK-002 BLOCKED, SECURITY BLOCKED, RELEASE NO-GO. Feasibility owner gate APPROVED; native solution and release gates NOT approved.
